bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
log=/tmp/video-two-build-v2.log
test -s "$log" || exit 71
if grep -qi 'ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE' "$log"; then exit 101; fi
if grep -Eqi 'Cannot find matching keyid|corepack|signature' "$log"; then exit 102; fi
if grep -Eqi 'ERR_PNPM_FETCH|ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION' "$log"; then exit 103; fi
if grep -Eqi 'ERR_PNPM|pnpm.*ERROR' "$log"; then exit 104; fi
if grep -Eqi 'Could not resolve|No matching export|Cannot resolve' "$log"; then exit 105; fi
if grep -Eqi 'No such file or directory|ENOENT|not found' "$log"; then exit 106; fi
if grep -Eqi 'Cannot find module|ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND' "$log"; then exit 107; fi
if grep -Eqi 'docker.*COPY|failed to calculate checksum|not found in context' "$log"; then exit 108; fi
if grep -Eqi 'ERROR.*RUN npm install -g pnpm' "$log"; then exit 109; fi
if grep -Eqi 'ERROR.*RUN pnpm install' "$log"; then exit 110; fi
if grep -Eqi 'ERROR.*RUN pnpm --dir.*build' "$log"; then exit 111; fi
exit 112
